practical_magnitude.w2_data_source_description: 100 random 16-type subsets from 80-rel pool (w2_practical_effect_results.json). Paper rounds IQR 0.0539→0.054, gap 2.16→2.2pp. CONSISTENT.
practical_magnitude.round2_data_source_description: Original n=25 batches from 80-rel experiment (round2_statistical_analyses.json → W2_practical_effect → 80pool_16sub). Same regression slope (-0.401) but different BCS distribution (Q1=0.5037, Q3=0.5692) yields larger IQR and gap.
